applicationName.description: Optional explicit name for the rendered ArgoCD Application. Defaults to a per-destination derived name to avoid collisions when deployed to multiple clusters.

destination.description: Argo destination for the rendered Application. Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name) — at least one required. Template prefers `name` when both are set. Must resolve to the WORKLOAD cluster: the DaemonSet ships the logs of the nodes it runs on.

clusterName.description: Value of the `cluster` label on every log stream. Required; the template fails when it is empty.

host.description: Loki gateway host, e.g. loki.platform.sthings.lab. Required; the template fails when it is empty.

tls.description: HTTPS with certificate verification against trustBundle. false only for a Loki in the same cluster.

tenantId.description: X-Scope-OrgID sent with every push. Empty = none (Loki with auth_enabled: false).

trustBundle.description: ConfigMap holding the CA bundle the Loki certificate is verified against. Mounted optional at /etc/ssl/custom.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the DaemonSet container.

extraValues.description: Deep-merged on top of the computed values passed to the upstream chart.
